gitCommit.subject: Increase screenshot timeouts for GitHub Actions compatibility
gitCommit.body:
Increase screenshot timeouts for GitHub Actions compatibility

- Increase CI screenshot timeout from 8s to 60s for all screen size tests
- GitHub Actions runners are slower than local machines, especially for:
  - Full page screenshot capture
  - Image comparison operations
  - Heavy DOM rendering
- Keep local timeout at 12s for faster development feedback
- Updated files:
  - visual-regression-minimal.spec.ts
  - core-panels.spec.ts
  - insights-analysis.spec.ts
- Consistent with global expect timeout of 45s in playwright config
